title: W3C Web Platform Incubator Community Group-relevant MDN issues
description: Issue filed on MDN Web Docs related to pages attached to technologies developed by W3C Web Platform Incubator Community Group

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/input/file

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Non-standard attributes

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

The section says that the webkitdirectory attribute is non-standard. It doesn't mention that it is being standardized.

What did you expect to see?

According to the other page on webkitdirectory it indicates that the attribute is now baseline which indicates that it's either part of the standard or almost part of the standard.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

  • MDN HTMLInputElement.webkitdirectory property
  • File and Directory Entries API Spec

Do you have anything more you want to share?

I'm not sure if this is officially part of the spec yet but all majors browsers have implemented it and it is part of a WICG spec which seems like a pretty good signal that it is ontrack to become standard if it's not quite there yet.

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/USB/requestDevice

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Parameters

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

The current documentation on MDN incorrectly states the USB requestDevice method takes an array of filters as the only parameter. However, the requestDevice method takes an object with a property filters which is an array.

Current version (minus some bits to make viewable here.)

## Syntax

requestDevice(filters)

### Parameters

- `filters`
  - : An array of filter objects for possible devices you would like to pair. Each filter
    object can have the following properties:
    - `vendorId`
    - `productId`
    - `classCode`
    - `subclassCode`
    - `protocolCode`
    - `serialNumber`

What did you expect to see?

Corrected version (minus some bits to make viewable here.)

## Syntax

requestDevice(options)

### Parameters
- `options`
  - : An object that sets options for selecting an appropriate device.
    The available options are:
    - `filters`
      - : An array of filter objects for possible devices you would like to pair. Each filter
        object can have the following properties:
        - `vendorId`
        - `productId`
        - `classCode`
        - `subclassCode`
        - `protocolCode`
        - `serialNumber`

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

The correct parameters can be seen on the below link that confirms this issue.
Device Enumeration

Do you have anything more you want to share?

I will push a pull request to fix this shortly.
